literal: By goodness of mind is attained the next world; and even that, by goodness of association, protection possesses.
translation: The bliss of the next world is attained through goodness of mind; yet, even that goodness of mind finds its secure protection in the goodness of one's association.
modern: மனத்தூய்மையினால் மறுமை இன்பம் உண்டாகும்; ஆனால், அந்த மனத்தூய்மையும் நல்லினத்தின் சேர்க்கையால்தான் வலிமை பெறும்.
explanation: This couplet explains the relationship between a pure mind and good company. While goodness of mind (மனநலம்) is essential to attain the virtues and rewards of the next life (மறுமை), that mental purity itself is not self-sustaining. It requires the safety, support, and reinforcement (ஏமாப்பு) that comes from being associated with good people (இனநலம்). Thus, keeping good company is the ultimate safeguard for one's own character and destiny.
